# Sun & Sand Offices

> This office building stands on a plot in Oud Metha, a central Dubai district bordered by Al Karama, Umm Hurair and Zabeel and served by the Green Line metro. Oud Metha combines schools, community clubs and hospitals with a cluster of corporate head offices along Umm Hurair Road, and the building adds office accommodation to that mix. It carries the Sun & Sand Sports name, a sportswear retail brand long established in the district.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Oud Metha, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

The Sun & Sand Sports Office Building is a commercial office building in Oud Metha, the central Dubai district where the sports retailer maintains its head office. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the building as subcontractor to Dubai Contracting Company, with Erga Progress Engineering as consultant, delivering the building services for its office accommodation.
